candidate.title: Multi-host Google Meet bookings create different Meet links per host calendar event
reports: [advisory] each per-host createevent call performs its own insert with conferencedataversion: 1, so a collective booking using google meet generates one conference per host calendar instead of one shared link. hosts 2..n get calendar events whose meet link differs from the link attendees receive (the booking stores the first result), so participants join different meetings.
